verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists a "Composer & Review Agent", which suggests a built-in agent inside Extend, but the pack has no documentation of what it does or how users delegate tasks to it. The MCP server, CLI and Agent Quickstart are for external agents connecting to Extend, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of the in-product assistant's capabilities, a description of how tasks are delegated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
